title: Document
description: One RIS decision: RIS metadata plus text and structure extracted deterministically from the RIS XML. Citations are a separate derived object.

ecli.description: ECLI as given by RIS. Never derived from the RIS ID (the suffixes can differ).

case_number.description: First case number (Geschaeftszahl) in the RIS metadata.

case_numbers.description: All case numbers the decision covers: the RIS metadata plus joined case numbers printed at the head of the decision. The first item equals case_number.

document_numbers.description: Case numbers with the document suffix as printed at the head of the decision (BVwG: 'L519 2309863-1/7E'). Distinguishes decisions that share a case number. Empty if the decision prints none.

decision_date.description: RIS Entscheidungsdatum. For orally pronounced decisions this is the date of the written copy.

pronouncement_date.description: Date of oral pronouncement ('mündlich verkündet') stated at the head of the decision, else null.

decision_type.description: RIS Entscheidungsart normalised: Erkenntnis -> judgment, Beschluss -> order (also ErkenntnisVS / BeschlussVS of a reinforced senate of the VwGH). The raw value stays in ris_metadata.

ris_metadata.description: The RIS OGD API record Data.Metadaten, verbatim.

full_text.description:
Deterministic text of the decision, built from the RIS XML (not the HTML). (1) Units: one paragraph per RIS paragraph element (), list item (: its symbol, a space, the text) and list closing paragraph (, ), and one per table row (see paragraph). (2) Left out: page headers and footers, the RIS header fields (Gericht, Entscheidungsdatum, Geschäftszahl, ECLI), the RIS field labels, the editorial VfGH Leitsatz (kept in ris_metadata) and images. (3) Inline elements: -> '-'; ,
, , -> space; , , -> '&', '<', '>'. (4) Characters: U+00A0 -> space; U+00AD removed; Word symbol-font bullets U+F0B7 and U+F095 -> '•', U+F02D -> '-'; every other character unchanged. (5) Whitespace runs -> one space; each paragraph trimmed. (6) Paragraphs joined by a single '\n'. (7) Footnotes (/): one paragraph per footnote, after all other paragraphs, in a section of type other with source_label 'Fußnoten'; the reference marks carry no text.

offset.description: Character offset into full_text (start inclusive, end exclusive).

section.description: A contiguous run of paragraphs. Types may repeat (a document can contain several decisions).

type.description: subject: introductory part naming court, parties and challenged act (VwGH 'Betreff'; BVwG head of the 'Spruch' up to the sentence ending 'zu Recht erkannt:' / 'beschlossen:'). operative_part: the operative provisions. reasoning: 'Begründung' / BVwG 'Text'. other: any other RIS field.

source_label.description: The label of the RIS field the section comes from (Betreff, Spruch, Begründung, Text, ...), else its field code; 'Fußnoten' for the footnotes.

paragraph.description: One RIS paragraph element (<absatz>), list item (<listelem>) or list closing paragraph (<schluss>, <schlussteil>) whose text is not empty after normalisation (see full_text). A leading structural margin number is moved to marginal_number. Tables: one paragraph per row; each cell's paragraph elements are joined by a space, the cells are joined in column order by ' | ', empty cells are kept so the columns stay aligned, and rows whose cells are all empty are dropped; a table nested in a cell is part of that cell's text (only the rows of the outer table are paragraphs). full_text[start:end] == text.

marginal_number.description: Margin number (Randzahl) that the RIS XML marks structurally (a number followed by a tab at the start of the paragraph, used by the VwGH); removed from text, except in a paragraph that holds nothing else. Outline labels such as '1.1.', 'II.' or 'a)' stay in the text.
